Virginia State Senator Faces Federal Charges in Marijuana Business Case

Virginia State Senator has surrendered to federal authorities following an indictment related to a public corruption case. The senator is accused of shielding a marijuana business. In response, the senator stated they "will not be bullied" and are blasting the DOJ indictment.
